sourceSelection.selectionMethod: Starter whitelist uses large U.S. Gulf Coast PADD 3 refinery rows from the EIA/HIFLD shapefile, with nearby overlapping complexes reduced by operator judgment. Product terminals and global infrastructure trackers remain future reviewed scopes.
sourceSelection.bboxRule: Convert each source point to a +/-0.05 degree FIRMS Area API watch box. The box is a thermal-observation proxy, not a facility boundary.

notes: Starter production whitelist uses directly downloadable EIA/HIFLD public refinery point data instead of manually invented coordinates.
Scope is intentionally conservative: U.S. Gulf Coast refineries only, no product terminals yet, no global refinery/terminal list yet.
Each bbox is a small FIRMS query box derived from an official point, not an exact refinery polygon.
This config never stores MAP_KEY and never approves thermal detections as incidents, outages, supply disruptions, or oil-price direction.
